app.title: Multi-Bot Dashboard
app.askAdmin: Ask a server administrator for access.

config.title: Configuration
config.subtitle: One tile per thing the bot does. Open one to change it.
config.noConfigFile: There is no config/config.jsonc yet, so the bot is running on the shipped defaults. Saving anything here creates the file.
config.guildMissing: No server id is set, so no commands can be registered. Fill it in under “Roles and channels”.
config.lookupsUnavailable: The role and channel pickers are unavailable: {error} You can still paste ids by hand.
config.lookupsUnavailableShort: Pickers unavailable, paste ids by hand: {error}
config.incompleteBanner_one: 1 feature is switched on but not finished, so it is doing nothing.
config.incompleteBanner_other: {count} features are switched on but not finished, so they are doing nothing.
config.missingList: Switched on, but still missing: {list}. Until then it does nothing.

texts.title: Messages
texts.subtitle: Everything the bot says. {total} messages, {changed} changed.
texts.search: Search a key or a message…
texts.listHint: A list. Change it in the raw editor of config/texts.jsonc.

bot.title: Bot control
bot.updateHint: git pull, npm install and a restart. Watch the console below.
bot.consoleHint: The bot's own output, live. The last {max} lines are kept.

points.title: Points
points.adjustHint: Added to what somebody already has, not set as a new total. A balance never goes below zero.

access.title: Permissions
access.overrideNotice: An entry for a USER replaces that person's role entries instead of adding to them, which is how you take one permission away from somebody their role would otherwise grant it to. The server owner always has everything and cannot be locked out.
access.grantHint: Pick a role or paste a user id, then tick what they may do.
access.empty: Nobody but the server owner, who always has everything.

settings.title: Appearance
settings.accentHint: Re-themes the whole panel for everybody. It has nothing to do with the colour the bot uses in Discord, which lives in the bot's own branding settings.
settings.notAHex: That is not a hex colour.
settings.faviconHint: PNG or ICO, up to 256 KB. The type is read from the file itself, not from its name.
settings.faviconCustom: A custom favicon is in use.
settings.faviconDefault: The built-in favicon is in use.

inputs.heading: Heading
inputs.buttonIdWarning: Changing the id orphans buttons on panels you already posted.

branding.label: Branding
branding.description: Name, colour, logo and the link buttons under every panel.

presence.label: Bot status
presence.description: What each of the three bots shows under its name.

roles.label: Roles and channels
roles.description: The roles and channels every other feature refers to by name.

logging.label: Server logging
logging.description: Joins, bans, edits, deletions, roles, voice and invites.

memberCount.label: Member counter
memberCount.description: Renames a channel to show how many members the server has.

feedback.label: Feedback channel
feedback.description: Turns a plain message into an embed staff can comment on.

autoReply.label: Auto-reply
autoReply.description: Points people at a contact when they ask for them by name.

rules.label: Rules panel
rules.description: The rules and the button that hands out the member role.

roleMenu.label: Self-assign roles
roleMenu.description: The button panel members use to pick their own roles.

guessNumber.label: Guess the number
guessNumber.description: The /random and /rg giveaway game, with its rate limit.

minigames.label: Minigames
minigames.description: Twelve games, what each outcome pays and the reward tiers.

moderation.label: Moderation tools
moderation.description: /clear, the message context menus and the database backup.

commands.label: Commands
commands.description: Rename, switch off or restrict every slash command.

branding.name.label: Bot name
branding.name.help: Empty uses the Discord server's own name.

branding.thumbnailUrl.label: Logo URL
branding.thumbnailUrl.help: Empty means no thumbnail and no footer icon.

branding.links.label: Link buttons
branding.links.help: Up to five. An entry without a URL is left out.

features.logging.channelId.label: Log channel
features.logging.channelId.help: Empty uses the general log channel.

features.memberCount.intervalMinutes.label: Update every (minutes)
features.memberCount.intervalMinutes.help: Discord allows two renames per ten minutes, so five is the floor.

features.feedback.dmOnComment.label: DM the author when it is commented

features.guessNumber.maxGuessesPerRound.label: Guesses per round
features.guessNumber.maxGuessesPerRound.help: The rate limit, not the randomness, is what protects the prize.

features.minigames.trivia.useApi.label: Pull trivia questions from opentdb.com
features.minigames.trivia.useApi.help: The API is English only. Switch it off when the bot runs in another language.

features.clear.maxMessages.label: Maximum messages per /clear
features.clear.maxMessages.help: Discord refuses more than 100 per call, so this can only ever lower the ceiling.

features.backupDatabase.enabled.label: Enable /backup_database
features.backupDatabase.enabled.help: Needs mysqldump on the machine and the DB_* credentials in .env.
